deu-29-7.anchor: And when ye came unto this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, came out against us unto battle, and we smote them:

deu-29-8.anchor: And we took their land, and gave it for an inheritance unto the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half tribe of Manasseh.

deu-29-9.anchor: Keep therefore the words of this covenant, and do them, that ye may prosper in all that ye do.

deu-29-10.anchor: Ye stand this day all of you before the LORD your God; your captains of your tribes, your elders, and your officers, with all the men of Israel,

deu-29-14.anchor: Neither with you only do I make this covenant and this oath;

deu-29-24.anchor: Even all nations shall say, Wherefore hath the LORD done thus unto this land? what meaneth the heat of this great anger?

deu-30-7.anchor: And the LORD thy God will put all these curses upon thine enemies, and on them that hate thee, which persecuted thee.

deu-30-8.anchor: And thou shalt return and obey the voice of the LORD, and do all his commandments which I command thee this day.

deu-30-12.anchor: It is not in heaven, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go up for us to heaven, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?

deu-30-15.anchor: See, I have set before thee this day life and good, and death and evil;

deu-30-18.anchor: I denounce unto you this day, that ye shall surely perish, and that ye shall not prolong your days upon the land, whither thou passest over Jordan to go to possess it.

deu-31-4.anchor: And the LORD shall do unto them as he did to Sihon and to Og, kings of the Amorites, and unto the land of them, whom he destroyed.

deu-31-10.anchor: And Moses commanded them, saying, At the end of every seven years, in the solemnity of the year of release, in the feast of tabernacles,

deu-31-13.anchor: And that their children, which have not known any thing, may hear, and learn to fear the LORD your God, as long as ye live in the land whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.

deu-31-15.anchor: And the LORD appeared in the tabernacle in a pillar of a cloud: and the pillar of the cloud stood over the door of the tabernacle.

deu-31-18.anchor: And I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evils which they shall have wrought, in that they are turned unto other gods.

deu-31-22.anchor: Moses therefore wrote this song the same day, and taught it the children of Israel.

deu-31-30.anchor: And Moses spake in the ears of all the congregation of Israel the words of this song, until they were ended.

deu-32-1.anchor: Give ear, O ye heavens, and I will speak; and hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.

deu-32-11.anchor: As an eagle stirreth up her nest, fluttereth over her young, spreadeth abroad her wings, taketh them, beareth them on her wings:

deu-32-26.anchor: I said, I would scatter them into corners, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men:

deu-32-28.anchor: For they are a nation void of counsel, neither is there any understanding in them.

deu-32-31.anchor: For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves being judges.

deu-32-34.anchor: Is not this laid up in store with me, and sealed up among my treasures?

deu-32-37.anchor: And he shall say, Where are their gods, their rock in whom they trusted,

deu-32-40.anchor: For I lift up my hand to heaven, and say, I live for ever.

deu-32-46.anchor: And he said unto them, Set your hearts unto all the words which I testify among you this day, which ye shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.

deu-32-47.anchor: For it is not a vain thing for you; because it is your life: and through this thing ye shall prolong your days in the land, whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.

deu-32-48.anchor: And the LORD spake unto Moses that selfsame day, saying,

deu-32-52.anchor: Yet thou shalt see the land before thee; but thou shalt not go thither unto the land which I give the children of Israel.

deu-33-6.anchor: Let Reuben live, and not die; and let not his men be few.

deu-33-15.anchor: And for the chief things of the ancient mountains, and for the precious things of the lasting hills,

deu-33-18.anchor: And of Zebulun he said, Rejoice, Zebulun, in thy going out; and, Issachar, in thy tents.

deu-33-22.anchor: And of Dan he said, Dan is a lion's whelp: he shall leap from Bashan.
